itachi-re-claude-skills-humanizer.description: Rewrites or drafts prose so it reads like a person wrote it, not an LLM — strips out AI vocabulary tells (delve, boast, intricate, testament, leverage, robust, seamless), robotic structures ("not X, but Y," rule-of-three padding, dangling "-ing" clauses, fake-suspense openers, phantom attribution like "critics argue"), uniform sentence rhythm, em-dash overuse, and mechanical bold/bullet formatting — without overcorrecting into forced typos or performed quirkiness. ALWAYS consult this before finalizing any prose for a human reader: emails, texts, DMs, social posts, comments, forum replies,…
